II-18 (PDF 35): pin-by-pin use; serial data from IC310 SDO1 on DA-L only (DA-R grounded), LRCK/BCK from IC303 pins 208/207 and DACCK, shared with IC310/IC311; current outputs into IC314 (M5218AFP) I/V converters (6.8k||680p, 34.4 kHz roll-off); X301 printed 36.8688 MHz (not a 44.1 kHz multiple; possible misprint of 33.8688). kn5000-mhj: 2026-10-31 (wave 4, lane kn5000-b/hwaudio): boot timeline MEASURED in MAME (kn7000_mame kn5000 driver, binary kn5000dsp_build/kn7000 sha256 26586387..., v10 + v1.42, cold boot) by a committed Lua tap, notes/open4-kn5000-b/hwaudio/probes/boot_timeline_tap.lua (output boot_timeline.txt): SubCPU_Send_Payload 0.600 s, tone database 1.46 s, payload-image decompression 1.02 s, executable 0.87 s, sub-CPU PAYLOAD_ENTRY 3.961 s, Audio_System_Init 3.968 s, ScreenGroup_Dispatch 4.865 s, InitializeGraphics 5.505 s, MainLoop 7.693 s, AcWelcomScreenProc 7.749 s. kn5000-1oy: 2026-10-31 (wave 4, lane kn5000-b/hwaudio): SPLIT. (1) The 0x130000 block's registers 0x10-0x17: firmware use fully mapped. Static: only DSP_Init_Channels (payload) and INIT_TONE_GEN (boot ROM) write it, DSP_WriteAllChannelRegs is never called, nothing reads it. Measured in MAME (notes/open4-kn5000-b/hwaudio/probes/subcpu_130000_write_tap.lua, output subcpu_130000_writes.txt): 144 writes, 0 reads in 22.8 s; the 0x5A5A5A5A pattern never reaches the block (argument registers swapped: one group written four times with SFR bytes, 0x50-0x57 boot ROM, 0x10-0x17 payload); the mode loop writes 0x01 to 0x1F/0x3F/0x5F/0x7F. Source comments updated in v142 (v141/v140 regenerated) and the boot ROM. The chip that decodes the block is BLOCKED: it needs the sub CPU's chip-select setup (in IC30's unread 97 %, BAD_DUMP) or a board continuity check from IC27's CS pins. (2) The R1 decode cascade (bit-11 lo12 first, then f31 3..7, ACT 0x0B, classes 0/1/4) and (3) the reverb micro-topology are proposed as new issues: open research, nothing external blocks them. Website page draft (audio-subsystem.md 0x130000 section): notes/open4-kn5000-b/hwaudio/README.md section kn5000-1oy.
